'''Armatan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Minister of the Interior/Legends|Minister of the Interior]] for the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] and, later, the [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], replacing the disgraced [[Almec/Legends|Almec]].

==Biography==
[[File:Armatan-Corruption.png|thumb|left|170px|Armatan seated at a meeting of the Ruling Council]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Armatan served as a member of the [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|Ruling Council]], a council of officials charged with governing the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]]. He and the other ministers were present in the New [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to discuss the problem of closed trade routes and their reliance on the corrupt black market as a result of the raging war.

Following the ouster of [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] [[Almec/Legends|Almec]], who had engineered a [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|black market crisis]], Armatan took over as Prime Minister. When [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|took over]] Sundari, Armatan was replaced as Prime Minister by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]].

Former [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] later revealed that all her supporters had either sided with Vizsla or had been killed.
